exposure: admission to neonatal intensive care unit with <100 VPTN admissions/year
Neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
cohort: 29,010 very preterm neonates (gestation 22 to <32 weeks) without major malformations admitted between 1 January 2009 and 31 December 2018
finding: Survival of very preterm neonates improved modestly over the 10-year period, and failure to use antenatal steroids, LSCS, eCPAP, and surfactant therapy, and failure to prevent admission hypothermia and late-onset sepsis increased the risk of mortality.
mod_finding: Lower segment caesarean section was associated with improved survival.
birth_weight: Mentioned as a predictor of mortality
